main_body: Tall thin palm: a brown trunk about 3px wide (rows 18-54) under a dark-green frond crown (rows 0-22) with a light-green centre patch.
top_band: Light green crown patch (L≈142, #71a854) at rows 2-6 in column x=16, closed by a dark row at row 7, then darker fronds from row 8 down.
evidence: The crown reads as a lighter top surface (rows 2-6, a step of more than 80 L) above darker drooping fronds, separated by a dark edge row at row 7. The fronds below it (rows 8-17, L 28-55) act as the shaded front. The trunk is a plain vertical column with no cap, but it is a slim organic stem rather than the main horizontal-surface volume. This is an acceptable organic 3/4 reading, though a marginal one.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 13 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The canopy has roughly 5 greens, but the fronds are large blocky shapes with little clumping or per-leaf highlighting. The trunk has only two alternating browns (L 46 and 73) in a mechanical 2-row banding, so it is a thin 2-step ramp. Dark edge pixels are only 16% neutral, so the outline is tinted but mixed; much of the canopy edge is a near-black green (#0b1812). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, but that is because everything is dithered into narrow bands rather than richly textured. Next to the lush references it looks much thinner and simpler.
